items.q: Does a team of coding agents beat a solo agent?
items.a: Yes, by ~**10 points**, but at **4-7x the cost**—so treat it as a compute allocation choice.

items.q: Why did async leads underperform blocking leads?
items.a: They **built on guesses** before worker reports arrived, then ignored or redid the work—unless told **when to wait**.

items.q: Where do extra workers pay off most?
items.a: At the **bottleneck stage**: planning/exploration on ProgramBench, implementation on Commit0.
In **one early burst** of discovery—delegating all the way through added ~830 calls and **no reward**.

items.q: What's the rule for mixing models?
items.a: **The lead sets the ceiling, the workers set the price**—strong lead, cheap workers.
No: **84%** of messages went to the lead, and chatter **hurt weaker teams** by 4-7 points.
